description: Eighth converted statistics pass. Adds Hypertext d20-compatible role stat blocks for undead crew, helmsmen, stormcallers, boarding marines, and repairwrights of the Undead Acropolis.

entries.title: Undead Air Sailors of the Acropolis
entries.summary: Intelligent skeletal and wraithlike sailors bound to ancient airships, skilled in natural magic, shipcraft, pursuit, and frozen-sky warfare, now with converted Hypertext d20-compatible role statistics.
body: The undead air sailors of the Acropolis are the cursed remains of a sky-commanding civilization. Their bodies have become bone, frost, shadow, or half-incorporeal memory, but their professional knowledge remains intact.
They continue to crew ancient vessels, read wind and pressure, repair cursed hulls, summon storms, board trespassing ships, and enforce the dead city's blockade with disciplined patience.

sections.heading: Conversion posture
body: The source explicitly proposes five conversion roles: crew, helmsman, stormcaller, boarding marine, and repairwright. This pass treats them as a coordinated undead ship crew package rather than five unrelated monsters.
All five retain intelligence, professional memory, immunity to cold, and competence aboard bone-and-shadow vessels.

statBlocks.title: Undead Acropolis Crew
statBlocks.fullAttack: Ancient cutlass +6 melee (1d6+3 plus 1 cold) or frostbow +5 ranged (1d8 plus 1d4 cold)
specialAttacks: Rigging Ambush (Ex): While aboard an airship, the crew member may move through rigging, spars, ladders, and narrow maintenance passages without treating them as difficult terrain. If it begins combat above or behind a target, it gains +2 on its first attack.
Dead Sailor's Grip (Ex): Gains a +4 racial bonus on Climb, Profession (sailor), and checks made to avoid being thrown, blown, or knocked from a vessel.
Frozen Cut (Su): Once per round, a successful melee attack deals an additional 1d4 cold damage to a living target.
statBlocks.environment: Undead Acropolis, cursed airways, bone-and-shadow ships
statBlocks.organization: Work detail (4-12), watch (10-30), or full crew (30-100)
statBlocks.treasure: Standard equipment, usually ancient and frost-bound
tactics: Works in disciplined groups to hold decks, rigging, and access points.
Prioritizes ship duties until specifically ordered into combat.
Uses elevation and narrow ship passages to isolate boarders.
conversionNotes: Baseline role for the intelligent skeletal and wraithlike sailors described in the source.
Designed to function as actual crew with combat capability rather than ordinary skeletons.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: The Undead Acropolis and the Watchers of the Frozen Skies

statBlocks.title: Undead Acropolis Helmsman
speed: Fly 40 ft. (perfect) while aboard its assigned vessel
statBlocks.fullAttack: Helm-hook +8 melee (1d8+2 plus 1d6 cold) or spectral command +8 ranged touch (2d6 force)
specialAttacks: Dead Reckoning (Su): The Helmsman always knows the position, facing, speed, and structural condition of its assigned vessel, even while separated by up to 1 mile.

Command the Wind (Su): As a standard action, the Helmsman alters wind direction and force in a 300-ft. radius by one category for 5 rounds. Hostile vessels must succeed on a DC 21 control check or turn 45 degrees and lose half speed.

Ghost Helm (Su): While touching a ship's helm, wheel, core cradle, or steering conduit, the Helmsman may control the vessel even if the normal helm is broken, frozen, or unpowered. The ship moves at half normal speed and ignores the first failed control check each round.
Course Denial (Su): Once every 1d4 rounds, one vessel within 500 ft. must succeed on a DC 22 Will or control check or be unable to move closer to or farther from the Helmsman's vessel for 1 round.
specialQualities: Incorporeal movement through its assigned vessel
statBlocks.environment: Cursed airways and undead fleet vessels
statBlocks.organization: Solitary officer with one vessel crew
statBlocks.treasure: Double standard, often including a helm token or route chart
tactics: Remains at the helm unless the vessel is already lost.
Uses wind control and Course Denial to trap intruders within patrol formations.
Continues piloting after damage that would disable a living crew.
conversionNotes: Represents the source's retained wind-reading, navigation, and cursed-ship control knowledge.
Ghost Helm connects this creature directly to future bone-and-shadow vessel statistics.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: The Undead Acropolis and the Watchers of the Frozen Skies

statBlocks.title: Undead Acropolis Stormcaller
speed: Fly 50 ft. (good) in storm or fog
statBlocks.fullAttack: Storm staff +10/+5 melee (1d6+2 plus 2d6 cold) or frozen lightning +11 ranged touch (6d6 electricity and cold)
specialAttacks: Frozen Lightning (Su): 120-ft. line, 6d6 damage divided equally between electricity and cold, Reflex DC 23 half, every 1d4 rounds. Failed saves also reduce movement speed by 10 ft. for 1 round.

Call Dead Storm (Su): Three times per day, the Stormcaller creates a 500-ft.-radius storm lasting 10 minutes. Visibility falls to 30 ft., exposed living creatures take 1d6 cold damage per round, and hostile flying creatures must make DC 22 Reflex checks each round or lose 20 ft. of altitude.
Bind Sky Spirit (Su): Once per day, summon a Large air elemental or ice paraelemental for 13 rounds. The summoned spirit has the undead template and obeys the Stormcaller.

Turn the Sky to Ice (Su): Once per day, the Stormcaller freezes a 60-ft.-radius area of air for 5 rounds. Flying creatures treat the area as solid difficult terrain and take 4d6 cold damage when entering or beginning their turn within it; Reflex DC 23 half.
specialQualities: Natural-magic casting as a 10th-level druid, restricted to air, cold, weather, and spirit effects
statBlocks.environment: Frozen skies, cursed airways, undead warships
statBlocks.organization: Solitary specialist, pair, or storm cadre (1-3 with 10-30 crew)
tactics: Creates weather before boarding or pursuit begins.
Uses Turn the Sky to Ice to block escape corridors and flight lanes.
Supports helmsmen and boarding marines rather than fighting alone.
conversionNotes: Represents the source's natural magic, storm summoning, wind shaping, and spirit calling.
Built as the primary magical specialist aboard Acropolis vessels.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: The Undead Acropolis and the Watchers of the Frozen Skies

statBlocks.title: Undead Acropolis Boarding Marine
speed: Climb 30 ft. on vessels and rigging
statBlocks.attack: Frost boarding axe +12 melee (1d8+6 plus 1d6 cold)
statBlocks.fullAttack: Frost boarding axe +12/+7 melee (1d8+6 plus 1d6 cold) or grave harpoon +8 ranged (1d10+5 plus tether)
specialAttacks: Grave Harpoon (Ex): Range increment 30 ft. A hit tethers the target to the Marine or vessel. Escaping requires a DC 22 Strength or Escape Artist check. A tethered flying target has its speed reduced by half.
Boarding Lock (Ex): When the Marine hits a creature adjacent to a ship rail, hatch, or rigging point, it may attempt a bull rush or grapple without provoking.
Cold Discipline (Su): Allies with the Undead trait within 30 ft. gain +2 on attacks of opportunity and saves against fear while the Marine remains active.
No Quarter (Ex): Deals +2d6 damage against prone, grappled, tethered, or climbing targets.
statBlocks.environment: Undead warships and frozen boarding zones
statBlocks.organization: Fireteam (3-6), boarding section (8-20), or marine company (30-100)
tactics: Tethers mobile targets before crossing between vessels.
Controls ladders, hatches, rails, and narrow boarding lanes.
Works with Stormcallers to force enemies into frozen or unstable positions.
conversionNotes: Created from the source's retained warfare, shipboard discipline, and pursuit role.
Intended as the principal boarding-combat specialist of the ghost fleet.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: The Undead Acropolis and the Watchers of the Frozen Skies

statBlocks.title: Undead Acropolis Repairwright
speed: Climb 20 ft. on hulls and rigging
statBlocks.attack: Bone rivet hammer +8 melee (1d8+4 plus 1d4 cold)
statBlocks.fullAttack: Bone rivet hammer +8 melee (1d8+4 plus 1d4 cold) or spectral rivet +5 ranged touch (2d6 force)
specialAttacks: Emergency Rebuild (Su): As a full-round action, restore 3d8+8 hit points to an undead construct, bone-and-shadow vessel zone, or cursed object. A target may benefit once per round from any number of Repairwrights.
Frost Weld (Su): The Repairwright seals a breach, broken door, cracked hull, or damaged mechanism within 10 ft. The repair functions for 1 hour and has hardness 10 and 30 hit points.
Animate Rigging (Su): Once every 1d4 rounds, ropes, chains, sails, or spars in a 20-ft. radius entangle living creatures; Reflex DC 19 negates. The effect lasts 3 rounds.

Salvage the Fallen (Su): As a standard action adjacent to a destroyed undead ally, the Repairwright extracts usable bone and shadow, gaining 10 temporary hit points or granting 10 temporary hit points to an undead vessel or ally.
specialQualities: Can repair while exposed to severe weather
statBlocks.environment: Bone-and-shadow ships, Acropolis drydocks, frozen wreck fields
statBlocks.organization: Solitary specialist, repair detail (2-6), or dock crew (10-40)
statBlocks.treasure: Double standard tools, salvage, and ancient components
tactics: Avoids frontline combat and restores vessel zones, doors, and undead allies.
Uses Animate Rigging to delay boarders while repairs continue.
Prioritizes helm, propulsion, and hull integrity in that order.
conversionNotes: Represents the source's retained hull craft, repair knowledge, and ability to keep cursed ships operating through lethal weather.
Designed as a strategic support creature whose removal materially weakens an undead vessel.
